plot_agent_efficiency: run the script to plot agent efficiency metrics from repoprover runs directory
parse_session_events: parse session.jsonl files to extract agent outcomes and PR status from a run directory
analyze_agent_file: analyze a single agent JSONL file to extract stats like duration, tokens, and outcome
determine_agent_outcome: determine the final outcome category for an agent based on session and agent events
plot_fail_rate_over_time: plot the fail rate over time using a rolling window of agent outcomes
